## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 02.09.2026 - 03.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Lechef 123_, 02.10.2026, 1/5: "Why is this app so slow to update.It’s 2026 not 1990 when are you going to fix it"
            2. _pfalzblick_, 01.10.2026, 1/5: "Are you kidding me? It’s been buggy with the OS 26 versions. Now with OS 27 it’s close to unusable. Trainings won’t play or close in mid flight. This is ridiculous for a paid service. My devices involved are Apple TV HD, iPhone 16, polar grit x2 watch"
            3. _Appfan69_, 24.09.2026, 1/5: "Same bug after updating to IOS 27. Dev guys broke it again. Apparently the Dev guys do not read app reviews. I am done with exercise rings and Apple watch!!Relying on updates from Dev guys that probably don’t even wear the watch. Three version of Ultra watch now same bug and glitch!! There’s a serious bug with the Ultra watch. The exercise time “green number” does not update or get stuck randomly. Which is preventing me from closing my ring and possibly lose my streak. One time I did an extra 20 minutes and the exercise time did not reflect it. I had to reboot and even then I had to do another 10 minutes for the exercise time to update. I now have my exercise time set to 5 minutes just so I close my rings not lose my streak. Pretty serious bug for an expensive watch. Same bug even with latest software."
<!--/ir-theme-->
